1	# MP v2 — First-class co-op
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Online multiplayer v1 shipped and is live (v0.13.0, deployed + prod-validated on Vercel + Neon + Fly). It works, but it landed with six documented scope-cuts that make co-op feel like a demo rather than the real game:
6	
7	- **Vehicles can't be boarded online** — rafts/ships are gated off under server authority (a mounted pose is server-driven, which fought the client-owned pose stream).
8	- **Arrows don't replicate** — only the `arrowHit` event crosses the wire, so remote players never see arrows fly.
9	- **Progression only credits the host** — server rooms track no advancements/stats; they accrue to the (nonexistent) primary player.
10	- **Kill credit defaults to the host** — indirect kills (arrow, pet, explosion) credit the primary, not the actual killer.
11	- **Pets follow the nearest player**, not their owner.
12	- **No way to remove a griefer** — the game server has a `kick` endpoint but no player-facing control.
13	- **SP worlds don't follow you across devices** — the cloud-save transport is built but unwired.
14	
15	**Intended outcome:** close all of them so co-op plays like single-player and the account layer feels complete. Target release **v0.14.0**. This plan supersedes the completed v1 build + ship-and-validate plans that previously lived in this file.
16	
17	Exploration (three parallel Explore passes) confirmed the engine is already per-player-shaped for most of this: `PlayerState` owns `stats`/`advancements`/`inventory`/`xp` and serializes per-player (save v17), the advancements system (`recordEvent`/`evaluateAdvancements`) is already pure over a `PlayerState`, `removeMobAt` already has an (unused) `creditTo` param, and the client renderer already draws straight off `state.vehicles`/`state.projectiles`. The work is mostly **threading the acting player through a few boundaries** and **adding wire channels that copy the existing mob-replication skeleton**.
18	
19	## Approach
20	
21	One branch `feat/mp-v2`, phased commit slices, **one PR** (matching v1's convention and the user's stated preference). Verify gate green at each phase boundary.
22	
23	- **`PROTOCOL_VERSION` 1 → 2** (`lib/net/protocol.ts`): the wire changes are additive but the protocol is version-locked at the door (`claims.pv !== PROTOCOL_VERSION` → refuse), so bumping ensures a stale v1 client is cleanly refused by a v2 server during a deploy rollover.
24	- **No save-format or worldgen bump** — per-player stats/advancements and placed vehicles already persist in save v17; Seam G reuses the existing `sp-cloud` world kind + save blob. (Seam G adds one optional *local-manifest* field, `WorldMeta.cloudId`, which is not the world save format.)
25	- Each phase ships its own tests, docs, and CHANGELOG entry, per AGENTS.md.
26	
27	The four phases are largely independent; **Phase 4 (SP cloud-save) touches only the single-player/web side** and could run in any order. Recommended sequence is gameplay-parity first.
28	
29	---
30	
31	### Phase 1 — Live replication: vehicles + arrows (Seams A, B)
32	
33	**Goal:** remote players see arrows fly and boats move; boarding works in MP. Both copy the mob-replication skeleton (`collectMobPoses`/`MobPose`/`upsertReplicaMob`); the client render side already consumes `state.vehicles` (`GameRenderer.ts:215`) and `state.projectiles` (`:217`).
34	
35	- **Un-gate boarding under server authority:** `GameEngine.ts:857-859` currently skips `tryBoardAimedVehicle` on server/replica. Remove that gate (a right-click arrives as a `placeBlock` cmd, already a networked command). Ship step-on already fires server-side via `tickVehicles`.
36	- **Vehicle pose channel (mirror mobs):** new `VehiclePose { id, kind, x, y, z, yaw, riderId }` in `protocol.ts`; `collectVehiclePoses()` in `server/room.ts` beside `collectMobPoses`; carry in a new `TickMessage` field + `WorldSync`; `upsertReplicaVehicle()` in `NetworkSession.ts` populating `state.vehicles` (reuse `restoreVehicle`, `vehicles.ts:55`). **Fix the existing omission:** `applyWorldSync` (`NetworkSession.ts:231-246`) ignores `sync.vehicles` — restore it.
37	- **Mounted-player feedback (the reason boarding was cut):** the server owns a mounted player's position (driven by their input intents through `tickVehicles` — intents already arrive via `setPlayerInput` on every pose). Extend `SelfDelta` (`protocol.ts:122`) with `mountedVehicleId?` + authoritative `x/y/z/yaw` (only while mounted); emit in `buildSelfDelta` (diff via `conn.shadow`, `room.ts:63,502`); apply in `applySelfDelta` (`NetworkSession.ts:288`) — snap `self.position` like the `forcePose` handler. In the replica `step()` (`GameEngine.ts:519-524`), skip `tickPlayerMotion` for the local player when `mountedVehicleId !== null` so the server-driven position wins (kills the rubber-band). Keep `applyRemotePose`'s mounted reject (`GameEngine.ts:448`).
38	- **Arrow pose channel:** new `ProjectilePose { id, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz }` (velocity so `projectileVisuals` orientation works unchanged); `collectProjectilePoses()` — **no deadband**, emit all live ones every tick, prune-by-absence (arrows are ephemeral/fast); `upsertReplicaProjectile()` populating `state.projectiles`; snap-per-frame (skip interpolation — arrows outrun the 125 ms delay).
39	- **Tests:** `server/room.test.ts` (vehicle + projectile poses broadcast, mounted self-delta), `NetworkSession.test.ts` (upsert vehicle/projectile from wire; mounted snap), `GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts` (boarding accepted under server authority; replica skips local motion when mounted). **Docs:** protocol.md (new poses + PROTOCOL_VERSION 2), online.md (rafts/ships now boardable — remove the v1 caveat), architecture.md, CHANGELOG.
40	
41	### Phase 2 — Per-player attribution: progression, kill-credit, pets (Seams C, D, E)
42	
43	**Goal:** each player earns their own advancements/stats and gets credit for their own kills; pets follow their owner. C and D are the same underlying change — thread the **acting player** through two boundaries.
44	
45	- **Attribute events to the actor (C):** add an optional actor to the emit boundary — `emit(event, actorId?: PlayerId)` (`GameEngine.ts:1150`) — threaded from sites that already hold a `player` (the whole `dispatch` switch, resolved at `:672`; `removeMobAt`'s receiver). `observeProgress(event, actorId?)` (`:1166`) resolves `actor = actorId ? getPlayer(state, actorId) : primary`, then `recordEvent(actor, event)` + `evaluateAdvancements(actor)` **unchanged** (already pure per-player). Preserve the `advancementUnlocked` recursion guard; route its re-emit to the same actor.
46	- **Kill credit (D):** `removeMobAt` already has `creditTo?: PlayerState` with the loot/XP machinery wired (`awardXp(receiver,…)`) — it just has zero callers. Pass the killer at all four sites: melee → `player` (via a closure from the `attack` handler); arrows/spears → a new `owner?: PlayerId` on `ProjectileState`/`ThrownSpearState` captured at `spawnArrow`/spear-throw and forwarded through the widened `removeMobAt` dep signatures (`projectileAI.ts:9`, `spears.ts:53`, `mobAI.ts:226`); the explosion/mob-vs-mob death sweep (`mobAI.ts:504`) → the crediting player (pet kills credit `mob.owner`; TNT credits its igniter). The same resolved actor feeds C's attribution.
47	- **Per-player progression on the wire (C):** extend `SelfDelta` with `advancements?: string[]` + changed `stats?: [{id,value}]`; diff in `buildSelfDelta` against new `conn.shadow` slots; apply in `applySelfDelta` onto `self.advancements`/`self.stats` (reuse `serializeStats`/`restoreStats`, `save.ts:506`). This makes each client's own advancement-count snapshot correct.
48	- **Pet owner-follow (E):** in the ally branch of `tickMobs` (`mobAI.ts:345-361`), resolve `owner = mob.owner ? getPlayer(state, mob.owner) : null` and target `owner.position` for follow/teleport instead of `anchor` (nearest). Fallback when the owner is offline: idle (not nearest). `anchor`/`nearestPlayerTo` stays for wild-animal flee.
49	- **Tests:** `GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts` (two players each earn own advancements; a second player's kill credits them, not primary; arrow/pet kill credits shooter/owner; pet follows owner over a nearer stranger), plus the existing advancements/combat/mobAI suites stay green. **Docs:** architecture.md (per-player attribution), online.md (remove the "progression accrues to primary" caveat), CHANGELOG.
50	
51	### Phase 3 — Owner controls: kick + roster (Seam F)
52	
53	**Goal:** the world owner sees who's connected and can remove someone, in-game. Use a **protocol message**, not a web→game admin bridge (the bridge would add cross-deployment env/coupling against the stateless design; the protocol path reuses the exact owner-gate already in `handleMessage`).
54	
55	- **Wire:** add `KickMessage { t: "kick"; targetId }` to the `ClientMessage` union + a `readClientMessage` validator (`protocol.ts`). Server `handleMessage` `kick` case: `if (conn.role !== "owner") return; this.kick(message.targetId)` — mirrors the existing `setDifficulty` owner-gate (`room.ts:306`); reuses `Room.kick` (`room.ts:252`) and `conn.role` (already from the ticket).
56	- **Role to the client:** add `role` to `WelcomeMessage` (filled from `claims.role`), expose `session.role` — self-contained for the panel. (Alternative: thread `screen.world.role`, which the web already has but `onlineWorldMeta` currently drops.)
57	- **Roster to the UI:** add `session.roster(): {id,name}[]` (from `state.players` + `names`) and a `subscribeRoster` firing on `playerJoined`/`playerLeft`/`applyRoster`; add `session.kick(targetId)`.
58	- **UI:** new `components/game/RosterPanel.tsx` copying the `ChatPanel`/`ConnectionStatus` shape (subscribe/unsubscribe in `useEffect`), rendered online-only in `MinecraftGame.tsx:156-157`. Lists players; owners get a Kick button per non-self id.
59	- **Tests:** `protocol.test.ts` (kick validation), `server/room.test.ts` (owner kick via message; member's kick ignored), `NetworkSession.test.ts` (roster/kick send), `RosterPanel.test.tsx`. **Docs:** protocol.md (kick message), online.md/manual.md (owner controls), CHANGELOG.
60	
61	### Phase 4 — SP cloud-save autosync (Seam G)
62	
63	**Goal:** a signed-in player's single-player worlds sync to the cloud and follow them across devices. Transport (`lib/game/cloudSaves.ts` `pushSave`/`pullSave`, gzip, stamp cursor) and server (`worldsService` `get/putSaveBlob` LWW, `sp-cloud` kind) are **already built and tested** — this is wiring. **Opt-in per world** (an explicit "Sync to cloud" action), not automatic upload of every local world.
64	
65	- **Local↔cloud link:** add optional `WorldMeta.cloudId` (`lib/game/worlds.ts` — tolerate in the manifest sanitizer; `createWorld` gains a way to record it / materialize from a `WorldSummary`). Generalize `createOnlineWorld` (or a sibling) to send `kind: "sp-cloud"`.
66	- **World list (`WorldSelect.tsx`):** split `listOnlineWorlds()` by `kind` — `mp` → the existing Online Worlds join section (unchanged); `sp-cloud` → merge into the local list (materialize a local `WorldMeta` + pull on first play). An "Upload to cloud" action on a local world creates its `sp-cloud` row and links it.
67	- **Push on save (`useMinecraftGame.ts`):** after the existing `writeSave` in the autosave/quit/unmount paths (`:300,302,395,524`; all already `if (!online)`), a **debounced** `pushSave(cloudId, api.serialize())` when the world is cloud-linked and signed in. Note `beforeunload` cloud flush is best-effort only (`sendBeacon` can't set the required headers) — flush on quit/unmount instead.
68	- **Pull on play (`GameShell.tsx`):** cloud-linked worlds need an **async pull gate** before `setScreen('play')` — reuse the existing `connecting`/`connectError` "Joining…" modal (`GameShell.tsx:80-111,193-207`). `pullSave` → `writeSave(worldSaveKey,…)` → normal boot from disk.
69	- **Conflict (409):** `pushSave` already returns `"conflict"`; surface a keep-local (re-push after refreshing the base) vs adopt-remote (`pullSave`) prompt via the existing toast / `net-modal` pattern.
70	- **Tests:** `worlds.ts` cloud-link, `WorldSelect.test.tsx` (sp-cloud split/merge), a `GameShell` async-pull test; `cloudSaves`/`worldsService` suites already cover the transport/LWW. Optional e2e in `multiplayer.e2e.ts` (the stack + pglite are already wired). **Docs:** online.md (cloud saves now live), manual.md (worlds across devices), architecture.md, CHANGELOG.
71

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

## [Unreleased]

## [0.13.0] - 2026-07-04

### Added

- **Multiplayer hardening & ops**: the online session now survives dropped connections and ships an operator toolkit. The replica engine outlives its socket — a non-fatal drop (idle timeout, redeploy, network blip) walks a back-off ladder (1/2/4/8/8 s), mints a **fresh** join ticket each rung, and re-handshakes to re-sync the same world in place (an amber "Reconnecting…" badge, not a dead-end modal); fatal closes (bad ticket, kick, slow-client) don't retry. A `setSimulatedLatency(ms)` knob on `window.__monecraft.net` (and `NEXT_PUBLIC_NET_SIM_LATENCY_MS`) injects artificial delay for local testing. World owners can **revoke every outstanding invite link** in one click from the menu. The game server gains admin ops behind `ADMIN_TOKEN`: a per-room replay log (`GET /rooms/:id/log`) that `scripts/replay.ts` reconstructs offline, an owner **kick** (`POST /rooms/:id/kick/:playerId`), and `/rooms` bandwidth (`kbOutPerSec`) alongside the tick gauges — plus `scripts/loadSim.ts`, a synthetic N-client soak that reports server tick p95 vs the 50 ms budget for tuning `MAX_ROOMS`. Net constants are documented in tuning.md and an ops runbook in online.md.
- **Online co-op multiplayer**: 2–8 players in one shared, server-hosted world via a private invite link — the offline single-player game is entirely unchanged and still needs no account or connection. The menu grows an **Online Worlds** section (create a server-backed world, copy an invite link) and an **Account** panel (one-click guest, or upgrade to keep your worlds); opening an invite link (`/join/<token>`) signs the visitor in — as a guest if they're new — accepts the membership, and drops the world into their list. In-world you see the other players (named avatars overhead), share every block edit / mob / chest / day-night with them, and **chat** with `T`/`Enter`; a ping badge and disconnect notice track the connection. The client mounts the **same** renderer/audio/HUD/input stack on a _replica_ engine (`NetworkSession`, `lib/net/`): it worldgens byte-identically from the server's seed, applies the gzipped world sync, predicts only its own movement (streamed at tick rate; the server clamps speed/teleports and owns hunger/health/inventory via change-only self-deltas), renders remote players and mobs ~125 ms in the past from interpolation buffers, and reroutes gameplay commands up the wire through the engine's `routeDispatch` hook — so the input controller and every UI panel behave exactly as in single-player. Pause is personal (the world keeps running; "Save & Quit" becomes "Leave world"), the night skips only when everyone's in bed, and mining is server-confirmed (~1 RTT). A full-stack Playwright spec (`e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts`) drives two browsers through invite → join → shared edit → chat against the real Next app (on an in-process `pglite://memory` Postgres) and Bun game server, no external services. **v1 scope cuts**: rafts/ships aren't boardable online, in-flight arrows aren't replicated (only their hits), and advancements/stats accrue to the room's primary player only.
- **Multiplayer game server (groundwork)**: a Bun process hosting authoritative world rooms over WebSocket — protocol v1 (JSON envelopes + one gzipped world-sync frame; total validation of hostile input with a per-command allow-list), 20 Hz fixed-tick rooms with client-pose clamping (sprint-ceiling speed, jump/fall vertical, teleport rejection → forcePose) that keeps hunger/stats/fall-damage server-authoritative, change-only per-player self-deltas, deadbanded 10 Hz mob replication with 5 s keyframes, chat with rate limits, backpressure shedding + slow-client kicks, join-restore/leave-persist through the v17 save, 60 s dirty persistence + SIGTERM drain, idle room eviction, /health + token-guarded /rooms diagnostics, PERSISTENCE=memory for DB-less runs, a netProbe CLI client, and Dockerfile + fly.toml. The engine gains authority-aware remote-pose application and can construct playerless rooms (bootPlayer: false).
- **Online accounts, cloud saves & invites (groundwork)**: better-auth identities with instant anonymous guests — upgrading to a real account (sign-up or sign-in while playing as guest) re-parents the guest's worlds/memberships/invites onto the new account, proven by an integration test against real better-auth + real SQL (PGlite). Drizzle/Postgres schema for worlds, memberships, and invite links; membership-gated world CRUD; idempotent invite acceptance with expiry/max-uses; gzipped single-player cloud-save blobs with last-write-wins conflict detection; and 60-second HS256 join tickets — the only trust link the future game server needs (it never sees cookies). Menu gains an Account panel. Fully offline-first: until the player takes an online action, the client makes no auth requests at all.

### Changed

- **Multi-player engine core** (save **v16→v17**; single-player behavior unchanged — the full e2e suite passes as before): the engine now models N players in one world, with single-player as the one-entry case of the same state. `GameState.players: Map<PlayerId, PlayerState>` absorbs every per-player field (inventory, vitals, effects/xp/stats/advancements, death/respawn, mining/fishing/vehicle, per-player timers); the old flat fields remain as accessor aliases onto the primary player for the shell/tests/console, with an ESLint guard banning them inside engine systems. All 23 systems take the acting player explicitly: mobs hunt the nearest targetable player (Creative/Spectator excluded) and anchor flee/pet-follow on the nearest of any mode; arrows/explosions hit any/all players in range; spawn directors center waves on a random party member and scale the hostile cap by `ceil(players/2)`; dungeon spawners arm for any player in radius; random ticks split their budget across players; raid rewards pay every living player. The night skips only when **every** eligible player is in bed (new `wakeUp` command backs out pre-fade). `dispatch`/`applyLook` take the commanding player's id; `addPlayer`/`removePlayer` (join restores the persisted v17 slice, leave serializes it back), `setPlayerInput`, and the `authority`/`headless` engine options are the surface a multiplayer server drives. Saves migrate automatically (v16 flat fields wrap into `players: [{id:"local",…}]`; pet owners become real player ids).
- **Input intents** (no behavior change): the engine's `FrameInput` no longer carries DOM key codes, CapsLock, or pointer-lock state — the input controller reduces them to abstract movement intents (`forward/back/left/right/jump/sprint/crouch` + `mineHeld`). Key bindings and cursor capture now live entirely in `lib/game/input/inputController.ts`; the engine simulates the same regardless of input source, which is what a multiplayer client's per-tick intent packets (and a future keybinding screen) require.
- **Tick driver extraction** (no behavior change): the rAF loop's catch-up substepping moved from `useMinecraftGame` into `lib/game/engine/tickDriver.ts` (`createAccumulator`), alongside a new drift-corrected `createFixedTicker` — the 20 Hz driver a headless multiplayer server will step worlds with. Unit-tested with a fake clock (catch-up, debt-drop cap, no drift under chronically-late callbacks).

- **Phase 4 (cloud-save):** confirmed built. `pushSave`/`pullSave` with 409-conflict handling are done; `WorldSummary.kind` already exists in the data model (the UI just ignores it).

**Small corrections I'll fold in:** the plan's paths are systematically off by one dir — systems live in `lib/game/engine/systems/`, state in `lib/game/engine/state.ts`; `spawnArrow` is in `projectiles.ts` not `projectileAI.ts`; the projectile-vs-mob death site is `projectileAI.ts:124`. **My one genuine reservation:** Phase 1's mounted-player replication (server owns the mounted position, streamed via an extended `SelfDelta`, replica skips local motion while mounted) is the only genuinely *novel* piece — everything else is "copy a skeleton" or "thread a param." ## Approved Plan (edited by user):
# MP v2 — First-class co-op (execution plan)

## Context

Online multiplayer v1 shipped and is live (v0.13.0, deployed + prod-validated on Vercel + Neon + Fly). It works, but landed with six documented scope-cuts that make co-op feel like a demo rather than the real game:

1. **Vehicles can't be boarded online** — rafts/ships are gated off under server authority (a mounted pose is server-driven, which fought the client-owned pose stream).
2. **Arrows don't replicate** — only the `arrowHit` event crosses the wire, so remote players never see arrows fly.
3. **Progression only credits the host** — server rooms accrue advancements/stats to the primary player.
4. **Kill credit defaults to the host** — indirect kills (arrow, pet, explosion) credit the primary, not the killer.
5. **Pets follow the nearest player**, not their owner.
6. **No way to remove a griefer** — the game server has a `kick` endpoint but no player-facing control.
7. **SP worlds don't follow you across devices** — the cloud-save transport is built but unwired.

**Intended outcome:** close all of them so co-op plays like single-player and the account layer feels complete. Target release **v0.14.0**.

The engine is already per-player-shaped for most of this (save v17): `PlayerState` owns `stats`/`advancements`/`inventory`/`xp` and serializes per-player; `recordEvent`/`evaluateAdvancements` are per-`PlayerState`; `removeMobAt` already has an (unused) `creditTo` param with XP/loot wired; the renderer draws straight off `state.vehicles`/`state.projectiles`. Most work is **threading the acting player through a few boundaries** and **adding wire channels that copy the existing mob-replication skeleton**.

**All seams below were re-verified against current `main` (2026-07-04, HEAD 727ab9d).** Path/line corrections vs the prior draft are folded in. Key gotcha: engine subsystems live under **`lib/game/engine/systems/`** and **`lib/game/engine/state.ts`** (not `lib/game/systems/` / `lib/game/state.ts`); the renderer is **`lib/game/render/GameRenderer.ts`**; `MobPose` is defined in **`lib/net/protocol.ts:113`** (imported by `server/room.ts`).

## Delivery decisions (user-confirmed 2026-07-04)

- **One branch `feat/mp-v2`**, phased commit slices, **one PR** at the end (matches v1 + the "big work = one reviewable unit" rule).
- **Straight through** all four phases this session; run the **full verify gate green at each phase boundary**; commit focused slices; **stop before push** (no push/PR/tag without explicit user ask — standing preference).
- **Phase 4 is in scope** for v0.14.0.
- **`PROTOCOL_VERSION` 1 → 2** (`lib/net/protocol.ts:20`): additive wire, but version-locked at the door — `server/index.ts:93` checks the hello `protocol` field and `:95` checks `claims.pv`; both must equal `PROTOCOL_VERSION`, so a stale v1 client is cleanly refused during a v2 rollover.
- **No save-format or worldgen bump** — per-player stats/advancements + placed vehicles already persist in v17. Phase 4 adds one optional *local-manifest* field (`WorldMeta.cloudId`), which is not the world save format.

---

## Phase 1 — Live replication: vehicles + arrows

**Goal:** remote players see arrows fly and boats move; boarding works in MP. Copy the mob-replication skeleton (`collectMobPoses` `server/room.ts:472` → `MobPose` `protocol.ts:113` → `upsertReplicaMob` `NetworkSession.ts:248`, which also builds a per-entity interpolation buffer at `:280`). Render side already consumes `state.vehicles`/`state.projectiles` (`GameRenderer.ts:215,217`).

- **Un-gate boarding under server authority:** `GameEngine.ts:859` — `if (this.authority !== "server" && !this.replica && tryBoardAimedVehicle(state, player)) break;`. Remove the authority/replica guard (a right-click arrives as a networked `placeBlock` cmd; ship step-on already fires server-side in `tickVehicles`). Keep `applyRemotePose`'s mounted reject (`GameEngine.ts:448-449`).
- **Vehicle pose channel (mirror mobs):** new `VehiclePose { id, kind, x, y, z, yaw, riderId }` in `protocol.ts`; `collectVehiclePoses()` in `server/room.ts` beside `collectMobPoses`; carry it in a new per-tick `TickMessage` field. `upsertReplicaVehicle()` in `NetworkSession.ts` populating `state.vehicles` (reuse `restoreVehicle`, `lib/game/engine/systems/vehicles.ts:55`).
  - **Fix the existing omission:** `applyWorldSync` (`NetworkSession.ts:231-246`) restores mobs but silently drops the `vehicles` field that `WorldSync` already carries (`protocol.ts:108`). Restore `sync.vehicles` there too (full-keyframe path); the new `VehiclePose` channel handles per-tick deltas.
- **Mounted-player feedback (the reason boarding was cut):** the server owns a mounted player's position, driven by their input intents through `tickVehicles` (intents already arrive via `setPlayerInput` on every pose). Extend `SelfDelta` (`protocol.ts:122`) with `mountedVehicleId?: string | null` + authoritative `x/y/z/yaw` (emitted only while mounted). Diff/emit in `buildSelfDelta` against `conn.shadow` (`server/room.ts:502-536`, shadow type `:63-75`; note the full-resend reset at `room.ts:334`). Apply in `applySelfDelta` (`NetworkSession.ts:288`) — snap `self.position` like the `forcePose` handler. In the replica `step()` loop (`GameEngine.ts:519-524`) skip `tickPlayerMotion` for the local player when `mountedVehicleId !== null` so the server-driven position wins (kills rubber-band). **This is the one genuinely novel piece — build it first, test it hard.**
- **Arrow pose channel:** new `ProjectilePose { id, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz }` (velocity so `projectileVisuals` orientation works unchanged); `collectProjectilePoses()` — **no deadband**, emit all live ones every tick, prune-by-absence (arrows are ephemeral/fast); `upsertReplicaProjectile()` populating `state.projectiles`; snap-per-frame, skip interpolation (arrows outrun the ~125 ms buffer delay). `WorldSync` gains a `projectiles` keyframe field for join-time state.
- **Tests:** `server/room.test.ts` (vehicle + projectile poses broadcast; mounted self-delta emitted only while mounted). `NetworkSession.test.ts` (upsert vehicle/projectile from wire; mounted snap; `applyWorldSync` restores vehicles). `GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts` (boarding accepted under server authority; replica skips local motion when mounted). **Docs:** `protocol.md` (new poses + PROTOCOL_VERSION 2), `online.md` (rafts/ships boardable — drop the v1 caveat), `architecture.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Phase 2 — Per-player attribution: progression, kill-credit, pets

**Goal:** each player earns their own advancements/stats and gets credit for their own kills; pets follow their owner. Attribution (C) and kill-credit (D) are the same change — thread the **acting player** through two boundaries.

- **Attribute events to the actor (C):** widen the emit boundary to `emit(event, actorId?: PlayerId)` (`GameEngine.ts:1150`), threaded from sites that already hold a `player` (the whole `dispatch` switch; `removeMobAt`'s receiver). `observeProgress(event, actorId?)` (`:1166`) resolves `actor = actorId ? getPlayer(state, actorId) : primary`, then `recordEvent(actor, event)` + `evaluateAdvancements(actor)` **unchanged** (already per-`PlayerState`). Preserve the recursion guard (`:1154` — skips re-entry on `advancementUnlocked`) and route its re-emit to the same actor.
- **Kill credit (D):** `removeMobAt` (`GameEngine.ts:1296`) already resolves `receiver = creditTo ?? primary` (`:1302`) and calls `awardXp(receiver, …)` (`:1312`) — it just has **zero callers passing `creditTo`**. Pass the killer at all sites:
  - Melee → `player`, via the `attack` handler (`GameEngine.ts:869-887`, which already holds `player` but passes `this.removeMobAt` bare at `:883`).
  - Arrows/spears → a new `owner?: PlayerId` on `ProjectileState` (`lib/game/engine/state.ts:146`; today only `fromPlayer: boolean`) and a **brand-new** `owner?: PlayerId` on `ThrownSpearState` (`:166`, which has *no* owner field today). Capture at `spawnArrow` (`lib/game/engine/projectiles.ts:23`, extend `SpawnArrowOptions` `:4-10`) and at spear-throw (`tryThrowSelectedSpear`, invoked from `GameEngine.ts:847`). Forward through the widened `removeMobAt` dep signatures at the death sites: `projectileAI.ts:124` (projectile-vs-mob, currently 1-arg) and `spears.ts:93`.
  - Explosion / mob-vs-mob death sweep (`mobAI.ts:504-512`, death at `:511`) → the crediting player (pet kills credit `mob.owner`; TNT credits its igniter).
  - The same resolved actor feeds C's attribution.
- **Per-player progression on the wire (C):** extend `SelfDelta` with `advancements?: string[]` + changed `stats?: {id,value}[]`; diff in `buildSelfDelta` against new `conn.shadow` slots; apply in `applySelfDelta` onto `self.advancements`/`self.stats` (reuse `serializeStats` `save.ts:506`, `restoreStats` `:515`, `restoreAdvancements` `:527`). Makes each client's own advancement/stat snapshot correct.
- **Pet owner-follow (E):** in the `faction === "ally"` branch of `tickMobs` (`mobAI.ts:345-361`), resolve `owner = mob.owner ? getPlayer(state, mob.owner) : null` (helper at `players.ts:68`; `mob.owner` exists at `state.ts:107`) and target `owner.position` for follow/teleport instead of `anchor` (`nearestPlayerTo`, `:306`/`players.ts:87`). Fallback when the owner is offline: idle (not nearest). `anchor`/`nearestPlayerTo` stays for wild-animal flee.
- **Tests:** `GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts` (two players each earn own advancements; a 2nd player's kill credits them not primary; arrow/pet kill credits shooter/owner; pet follows owner over a nearer stranger). Existing advancements/combat/mobAI suites stay green. **Docs:** `architecture.md` (per-player attribution), `online.md` (drop the "progression accrues to primary" caveat), `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Phase 3 — Owner controls: kick + roster

**Goal:** the world owner sees who's connected and can remove someone, in-game. Use a **protocol message**, not a web→game admin bridge (the bridge would add cross-deployment coupling against the stateless design; the protocol path reuses the owner-gate already in `handleMessage`).

- **Wire:** add `KickMessage { t: "kick"; targetId }` to the `ClientMessage` union (`protocol.ts:74`) + a case in `readClientMessage` (`:256-284`, validate `isStr(m.targetId)`). Server `handleMessage` kick case mirrors the existing owner-gate (`room.ts:306`: `if (conn.role !== "owner") return; this.kick(message.targetId)`); reuses `Room.kick` (`room.ts:252`, already closes + `leave` + broadcasts `playerLeft`) and `conn.role` (from `claims.role`, `room.ts:220` / `tickets.ts:26`).
- **Role to the client:** add `role` to `WelcomeMessage` (`protocol.ts:80-92`), filled from `claims.role` where WELCOME is built (`room.ts:231-245`); expose `session.role`. Self-contained for the panel.
- **Roster to the UI:** add a roster subscription to `NetworkSession` copying the chat/status pattern (`subscribeChat`/`subscribeStatus` at `NetworkSession.ts:478-485`, backing `Set`s `:111-112`). New `Set` + `subscribeRoster()` firing on `applyRoster` (`:215`), `playerJoined` (`:375`), `playerLeft` (`:381`); `session.roster()` from `state.players` + `names` (`:123`, `playerName` `:489`); `session.kick(targetId)`.
- **UI:** new `components/game/RosterPanel.tsx` copying the `ChatPanel`/`ConnectionStatus` shape (props `{ session }`, `useEffect` subscribe→unsubscribe cleanup). Render online-only at `MinecraftGame.tsx:156-157` (beside the existing `{online && …}` panels). Lists players; owners get a Kick button per non-self id.
- **Tests:** `protocol.test.ts` (kick validation), `server/room.test.ts` (owner kick via message; member's kick ignored), `NetworkSession.test.ts` (roster/kick send + subscription fires), `RosterPanel.test.tsx`. **Docs:** `protocol.md` (kick message + role), `online.md`/`manual.md` (owner controls), `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Phase 4 — SP cloud-save autosync

**Goal:** a signed-in player's single-player worlds sync to the cloud and follow them across devices. Transport (`cloudSaves.ts` `pushSave`/`pullSave`, gzip, `x-base-updated-at` stale guard, 409→`"conflict"`) and server (`worldsService` `get/putSaveBlob` LWW, `sp-cloud` kind) are **already built and tested** — this is wiring. **Opt-in per world** (explicit "Upload to cloud"), not auto-upload of every local world.

- **Local↔cloud link:** add optional `WorldMeta.cloudId` (`lib/game/worlds.ts:21-36`). The sanitizer `sanitizeWorld` (`:88-111`) rebuilds a fresh object with only known keys, so `cloudId` must be **explicitly copied through** `sanitizeWorld` *and* `createWorld` (`:134-162`), else it's silently dropped. Parameterize `createOnlineWorld` (`onlineClient.ts:24-44`, currently hardcodes `kind: "mp"` at `:36`) to send `kind: "sp-cloud"` (server already accepts both — `worldsService.createWorld` validates the union, `:85`).
- **World list (`WorldSelect.tsx`):** `WorldSummary.kind` already exists (`worldsService.ts:21`) but the UI ignores it (`:181-241` renders every online world identically). Split `listOnlineWorlds()` by `kind`: `"mp"` → existing Online Worlds join section (unchanged); `"sp-cloud"` → merge into the local list (materialize a local `WorldMeta` + pull on first play). Add an "Upload to cloud" action on a local world that creates its `sp-cloud` row and links `cloudId`.
- **Push on save (`useMinecraftGame.ts`):** persistence runs through `persistGame` (`:87`, calls `writeSave`) at the autosave/gameOver/unmount/quit sites (`:300,329,395,524`), **all already `if (!online)`-guarded**. Alongside those, add a **debounced** `pushSave(cloudId, api.serialize())` when the world is cloud-linked and signed in. `beforeunload` cloud flush is best-effort only (`sendBeacon` can't set the required headers) — flush on quit/unmount instead.
- **Pull on play (`GameShell.tsx`):** cloud-linked worlds need an **async pull gate** before entering play. Reuse the `connecting`/`connectError` "Joining…" modal (`:80-81`, `:193-207`) that `playOnline` already uses — but resolve to the **SP** screen `{ name: "play", … }` (`:23-27`), *not* `play-online` (`:104`). `pullSave` → `writeSave(worldSaveKey, …)` → normal boot from disk.
- **Conflict (409):** `pushSave` returns `"conflict"`; surface keep-local (re-push after refreshing the base) vs adopt-remote (`pullSave`) via the existing `net-modal`/toast pattern.
- **Tests:** `worlds.ts` cloud-link round-trips the sanitizer; `WorldSelect.test.tsx` (sp-cloud split/merge); a `GameShell` async-pull test. `cloudSaves`/`worldsService` suites already cover transport/LWW. Optional e2e in `multiplayer.e2e.ts` (stack + pglite already wired). **Docs:** `online.md` (cloud saves live), `manual.md` (worlds across devices), `architecture.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

---

## Critical files

- **Protocol/wire:** `lib/net/protocol.ts` (PROTOCOL_VERSION 2; `VehiclePose`/`ProjectilePose`/`KickMessage`; `SelfDelta`/`WelcomeMessage`/`TickMessage`/`WorldSync` fields; validators), `lib/net/codec.ts` (unchanged).
- **Server:** `server/room.ts` (collect/broadcast poses, self-delta extensions, kick case, role in welcome), `server/index.ts` (unchanged — door lock already bumps with the constant).
- **Client session:** `lib/net/NetworkSession.ts` (upsert vehicle/projectile, mounted self-delta, roster/kick, role, `applyWorldSync` vehicles fix), `lib/net/NetworkSession.test.ts`.
- **Engine:** `lib/game/engine/GameEngine.ts` (un-gate boarding, replica mounted skip, `emit`/`observeProgress`/`removeMobAt` actor threading), `lib/game/engine/systems/{vehicles,projectileAI,spears,combat,mobAI,advancements}.ts`, `lib/game/engine/projectiles.ts` (`spawnArrow` owner), `lib/game/engine/state.ts` (`owner` on projectile/spear), `lib/game/engine/GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts`.
- **Client UI/shell:** `components/game/RosterPanel.tsx` (new), `components/MinecraftGame.tsx`, `components/GameShell.tsx`, `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx`.
- **SP save:** `lib/game/cloudSaves.ts` (built), `lib/game/worlds.ts` (`cloudId` + sanitizer), `lib/game/useMinecraftGame.ts` (push hook), `lib/online/onlineClient.ts` (sp-cloud create).
- **Docs:** `docs/protocol.md`, `docs/online.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/manual.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Verification

- **Per phase (the gate CI runs):** `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run format:check`, `bun test` — **assert real exit 0**, not just "0 fail" (the PGlite exit-99 lesson: unclosed fixtures exit 99 even when all tests pass; never gate on `bun test | tail`) — and `bun run build`. Add `bun run test:e2e` for phases touching renderer/input/shell (1, 3, 4).
- **Phase-specific unit tests** are the workhorse (headless two-player boarding, kill-credit attribution, per-player advancements, pet-follow) via `GameEngine.multiplayer.test.ts` + fake-socket `server/room.test.ts`/`NetworkSession.test.ts`. Local-fixture states use the self-referential `state.player = state` / `GameState & PlayerState` cast pattern already in the suite.
- **End-to-end (live):** the two-browser pass from v1 — board a boat together, see arrows fly, each earn a distinct advancement, kick a third guest, and (Phase 4) create a cloud world on one device and open it on another. Prod stack (Vercel + Neon + Fly) already deployed.
- **Release (end of branch, after user review):** bump to **v0.14.0** (version bump + CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`→`[0.14.0]` roll + `chore(release)` commit + tag), matching the v0.13.0 flow. **Do not push/tag until the user asks.**

## Out of scope (future thrusts)

Client-side movement prediction/rollback (the hybrid model already gives smooth own-movement); interest management / chunk streaming; PvP tuning; public rooms / matchmaking / moderation; SP→MP world conversion. Foundation/licensing (OSS license via upstream PR) remains a separate track.

46	/** The client-authoritative avatar pose, streamed at tick rate. */

48	  t: "pose";
49	  seq: number;
50	  x: number;
51	  y: number;
52	  z: number;

65	 * where the client actually looked.

94	/**

101	  tick: number;
102	  dayClock: number;

162	
163	export type ServerMessage =
164	  | WelcomeMessage
165	  | TickMessage
166	  | MobsKeyframeMessage
167	  | PlayerJoinedMessage
168	  | PlayerLeftMessage
169	  | ContainerMessage
170	  | ChatBroadcastMessage
171	  | PongMessage
172	  | ForcePoseMessage;

174	// ── validators (client → server only: the server is the hostile-input side) ──
175	
176	const isNum = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);
177	const isBool = (v: unknown): v is boolean => typeof v === "boolean";
178	const isStr = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === "string";
179	
180	function readMove(v: unknown): PoseMessage["move"] | null {
181	  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return null;
182	  const m = v as Record<string, unknown>;
183	  const keys = ["forward", "back", "left", "right", "jump", "sprint", "crouch"] as const;
184	  const out = {} as Record<(typeof keys)[number], boolean>;
185	  for (const key of keys) {
186	    if (!isBool(m[key])) return null;
187	    out[key] = m[key] as boolean;
188	  }
189	  return out;
190	}
191	
192	function readEyePose(v: unknown): CmdMessage["pose"] | null {
193	  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return null;
194	  const p = v as Record<string, unknown>;
195	  if (!isNum(p.x) || !isNum(p.y) || !isNum(p.z) || !isNum(p.yaw) || !isNum(p.pitch)) return null;
196	  return { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: p.pitch };
197	}
198	
199	/**
200	 * Command allow-list: every dispatchable type with per-field checks. Unknown
201	 * or malformed commands are dropped here — dispatch never sees them. Local-
202	 * presentation commands (pause/debug/camera) are deliberately absent: they
203	 * have no business on a wire.
204	 */
205	export function readCommand(v: unknown): Command | null {
206	  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return null;
207	  const c = v as Record<string, unknown>;
208	  switch (c.type) {
209	    case "selectSlot":
210	      return isNum(c.index) ? { type: "selectSlot", index: Math.floor(c.index) } : null;
211	    case "craft":
212	      return isStr(c.recipeId) ? { type: "craft", recipeId: c.recipeId } : null;
213	    case "swapSlots":
214	      return isNum(c.from) && isNum(c.to) ? { type: "swapSlots", from: Math.floor(c.from), to: Math.floor(c.to) } : null;
215	    case "moveStack":
216	      return isNum(c.from) && isNum(c.to) ? { type: "moveStack", from: Math.floor(c.from), to: Math.floor(c.to) } : null;
217	    case "toggleEquipArmor":
218	      return isNum(c.index) ? { type: "toggleEquipArmor", index: Math.floor(c.index) } : null;
219	    case "unequipArmor":
220	      return c.slot === "helmet" || c.slot === "chestplate" || c.slot === "leggings" || c.slot === "boots" ? { type: "unequipArmor", slot: c.slot } : null;
221	    case "anvilRename":
222	      return isStr(c.name) ? { type: "anvilRename", name: c.name.slice(0, 64) } : null;
223	    case "enchant":
224	      // Allow-list the id: an unknown one would throw in canEnchant (indexes
225	      // ENCHANTMENT_DEFS). hasOwnProperty (not `in`) so "__proto__"/"toString" don't slip through.
226	      return isStr(c.enchant) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ENCHANTMENT_DEFS, c.enchant)
227	        ? { type: "enchant", enchant: c.enchant as EnchantmentId }
228	        : null;
229	    case "creativeGiveItem":
230	      return isStr(c.itemId) ? { type: "creativeGiveItem", itemId: c.itemId } : null;
231	    case "setGameMode":
232	      return isStr(c.mode) ? ({ type: "setGameMode", mode: c.mode } as Command) : null;
233	    case "setDifficulty":
234	      return isStr(c.difficulty) ? ({ type: "setDifficulty", difficulty: c.difficulty } as Command) : null;
235	    case "toggleInventory":
236	    case "toggleAdvancements":
237	    case "eatFood":
238	    case "drinkPotion":
239	    case "anvilCombine":
240	    case "anvilRepair":
241	    case "grindstoneStrip":
242	    case "placeBlock":
243	    case "attack":
244	    case "toggleFlight":
245	    case "unstuck":
246	    case "respawn":
247	    case "dismissVictory":
248	    case "wakeUp":
249	      return { type: c.type } as Command;
250	    default:
251	      return null;
252	  }
253	}
254	
255	/** Parses one client frame (already JSON.parsed). Total: null for anything off-spec. */
256	export function readClientMessage(v: unknown): ClientMessage | null {
257	  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return null;
258	  const m = v as Record<string, unknown>;
259	  switch (m.t) {
260	    case "hello":
261	      return isStr(m.ticket) && isNum(m.protocol) ? { t: "hello", ticket: m.ticket, protocol: m.protocol } : null;
262	    case "pose": {
263	      if (!isNum(m.seq) || !isNum(m.x) || !isNum(m.y) || !isNum(m.z) || !isNum(m.yaw) || !isNum(m.pitch) || !isBool(m.onGround)) return null;
264	      const move = readMove(m.move);
265	      if (!move || !isBool(m.mineHeld)) return null;
266	      return { t: "pose", seq: m.seq, x: m.x, y: m.y, z: m.z, yaw: m.yaw, pitch: m.pitch, onGround: m.onGround, move, mineHeld: m.mineHeld };
267	    }
268	    case "cmd": {
269	      if (!isNum(m.seq)) return null;
270	      const cmd = readCommand(m.cmd);
271	      const pose = readEyePose(m.pose);
272	      if (!cmd || !pose) return null;
273	      return { t: "cmd", seq: m.seq, cmd, pose };
274	    }
275	    case "chat":
276	      return isStr(m.text) && m.text.trim().length > 0 ? { t: "chat", text: m.text.slice(0, 256) } : null;
277	    case "ping":
278	      return isNum(m.id) && isNum(m.tMs) ? { t: "ping", id: m.id, tMs: m.tMs } : null;
279	    case "resync":
280	      return { t: "resync" };
281	    default:
282	      return null;
283	  }
284	}

273	  async handleMessage(playerId: string, message: ClientMessage): Promise<void> {

280	        const elapsed = Math.max(1, this.tickCount - conn.lastPoseTick) * TICK_SECONDS;
281	        const { accepted } = this.engine.applyRemotePose(playerId, message, elapsed);
282	        this.engine.setPlayerInput(playerId, { move: message.move, mineHeld: message.mineHeld });
283	        if (accepted) {
284	          conn.lastPoseTick = this.tickCount;
285	        } else {
286	          const player = this.engine.state.players.get(playerId);
287	          if (player) {
288	            conn.sink.send(
289	              encodeServerMessage({
290	                t: "forcePose",
291	                x: player.position.x,
292	                y: player.position.y,
293	                z: player.position.z,
294	                yaw: player.yaw,
295	                pitch: player.pitch
296	              })
297	            );
298	          }
299	        }
300	        return;
301	      }
302	      case "cmd": {
303	        if (conn.budget.cmd >= 60) return; // per-second flood guard
304	        conn.budget.cmd += 1;
305	        // Room-wide settings are the owner's call, not any member's.
306	        if ((message.cmd.type === "setDifficulty" || message.cmd.type === "setGameMode") && conn.role !== "owner") return;
307	        // Apply the claimed pose (same clamps as the stream) so the command's
308	        // raycast happens from where the client actually stood/aimed.
309	        const elapsed = Math.max(1, this.tickCount - conn.lastPoseTick) * TICK_SECONDS;
310	        const { accepted } = this.engine.applyRemotePose(
311	          playerId,
312	          { ...message.pose, onGround: this.engine.state.players.get(playerId)?.onGround ?? false },
313	          elapsed
314	        );
315	        // Advance the pose clock on an accepted cmd pose too — otherwise a
316	        // client sending only cmds lets `elapsed` grow and inflate the clamp.
317	        if (accepted) conn.lastPoseTick = this.tickCount;
318	        this.recordLog({ tick: this.tickCount, playerId, cmd: message.cmd, pose: message.pose });
319	        this.engine.dispatch(message.cmd, playerId);
320	        return;
321	      }
322	      case "chat": {
323	        if (conn.budget.chat >= 3) return;
324	        conn.budget.chat += 1;
325	        this.broadcast({ t: "chat", from: playerId, name: conn.name, text: message.text });
326	        return;
327	      }
328	      case "ping": {
329	        conn.sink.send(encodeServerMessage({ t: "pong", id: message.id, tMs: message.tMs, serverTick: this.tickCount }));
330	        return;
331	      }
332	      case "resync": {
333	        conn.sink.send(await gzipWorldSync(this.buildWorldSync()));
334	        conn.shadow = null; // resend the full self-delta next tick
335	        return;
336	      }
337	      case "hello":
338	        return; // already admitted; ignore
339	    }
340	  }
341	
342	  /** Drains the room for shutdown: persist + close every socket. */
343	  async shutdown(): Promise<void> {
344	    this.ticker?.stop();
345	    for (const conn of this.clients.values()) conn.sink.close(CLOSE_SERVER_SHUTDOWN, "server restarting");
346	    for (const playerId of [...this.clients.keys()]) this.leave(playerId);
347	    await this.persist();
348	  }
349	
350	  /** Persists the full world (live players merged with offline slices). */
351	  async persist(): Promise<void> {
352	    const save = this.engine.serialize();
353	    for (const [id, saved] of this.offlinePlayers) {
354	      if (!save.players.some((p) => p.id === id)) save.players.push(saved);
355	    }
356	    const bun = Bun as unknown as { gzipSync(d: Uint8Array): Uint8Array };
357	    const blob = bun.gzipSync(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(save)));
358	    await this.persistence.storeWorld(this.worldId, blob, save.version);
359	    this.dirtySinceStore = false;
360	  }

362	  // ── internals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
363	
364	  private tick(dt: number): void {
365	    const started = this.now();
366	    this.tickCount += 1;
367	    if (this.tickCount % 20 === 0) {
368	      for (const conn of this.clients.values()) conn.budget = { cmd: 0, chat: 0 };
369	    }
370	
371	    this.engine.step(dt);
372	    const events = this.engine.consumeEvents();
373	    const blocks = this.engine.state.blockChanges.drainEdits();
374	    if (events.some((e) => e.type === "blockPlaced" || e.type === "blockBroken" || e.type === "explosion")) this.dirtySinceStore = true;
375	
376	    const mobPoses = this.collectMobPoses(false);
377	    const day = this.tickCount % DAY_INTERVAL_TICKS === 0 ? this.engine.state.dayClock : undefined;
378	
379	    for (const conn of this.clients.values()) {
380	      const buffered = conn.sink.bufferedAmount();
381	      if (buffered > BACKPRESSURE_KICK_BYTES) {
382	        conn.slowStrikes += 1;
383	        if (conn.slowStrikes > BACKPRESSURE_KICK_STRIKES) {
384	          conn.sink.close(CLOSE_SLOW_CLIENT, "client cannot keep up");
385	          this.leave(conn.playerId);
386	        }
387	        continue;
388	      }
389	      conn.slowStrikes = 0;
390	      const shed = buffered > BACKPRESSURE_SOFT_BYTES;
391	      const message: TickMessage = {
392	        t: "tick",
393	        n: this.tickCount,
394	        ...(blocks.length > 0 ? { blocks } : {}),
395	        ev: events,
396	        pp: shed ? [] : this.collectPlayerPoses(conn.playerId),
397	        mp: shed ? [] : mobPoses,
398	        ...(day !== undefined ? { day } : {}),
399	        ...(this.buildSelfDelta(conn) ?? {})
400	      };
401	      const encoded = encodeServerMessage(message);
402	      this.bytesOut += encoded.length;
403	      conn.sink.send(encoded);
404	    }
405	
406	    // Pose anchors between commands keep an offline replay's positions aligned.
407	    if (this.tickCount % POSE_CHECKPOINT_TICKS === 0) {
408	      for (const player of this.engine.state.players.values()) {
409	        this.recordLog({
410	          tick: this.tickCount,
411	          playerId: player.id,
412	          pose: { x: player.position.x, y: player.position.y, z: player.position.z, yaw: player.yaw, pitch: player.pitch }
413	        });
414	      }
415	    }
416	
417	    if (this.tickCount % KEYFRAME_INTERVAL_TICKS === 0 && this.clients.size > 0) {
418	      this.broadcast({ t: "mobsKeyframe", n: this.tickCount, mobs: this.collectMobPoses(true) });
419	    }
420	    if (this.tickCount % PERSIST_INTERVAL_TICKS === 0 && this.dirtySinceStore) {
421	      void this.persist();
422	    }
423	    this.slowestTickMs = Math.max(this.slowestTickMs * 0.99, this.now() - started);
424	  }

426	  private roster(): RosterEntry[] {
427	    const out: RosterEntry[] = [];
428	    for (const conn of this.clients.values()) {
429	      const player = this.engine.state.players.get(conn.playerId);
430	      if (player) out.push(this.rosterEntry(player, conn));
431	    }
432	    return out;
433	  }

435	  private rosterEntry(player: PlayerState, conn: ClientConn): RosterEntry {
436	    return {
437	      id: player.id,
438	      name: conn.name,
439	      skinId: conn.skinId,
440	      x: player.position.x,
441	      y: player.position.y,
442	      z: player.position.z,

447	  private buildWorldSync(): WorldSync {
448	    const state = this.engine.state;
449	    return {
450	      t: "worldSync",
451	      tick: this.tickCount,
452	      dayClock: state.dayClock,
453	      changes: state.blockChanges.changes(),
454	      blockEntities: serializeContainers(state.containers),
455	      lootedChests: serializeLootedChests(state.lootedWorldgenChests),
456	      mobs: serializeMobs(state.mobs),
457	      liveMobs: this.collectMobPoses(true),
458	      vehicles: serializeVehicles(state.vehicles),
459	      players: this.roster()
460	    };
461	  }
462	
463	  private collectPlayerPoses(except: string): PlayerPose[] {
464	    const out: PlayerPose[] = [];
465	    for (const player of this.engine.state.players.values()) {
466	      if (player.id === except) continue;
467	      out.push({ id: player.id, x: player.position.x, y: player.position.y, z: player.position.z, yaw: player.yaw, pitch: player.pitch });
468	    }
469	    return out;
470	  }
471	
472	  private collectMobPoses(keyframe: boolean): MobPose[] {
473	    const out: MobPose[] = [];
474	    for (const mob of this.engine.state.mobs) {
475	      const shadow = this.mobShadow.get(mob.id);
476	      const moved =
477	        !shadow ||
478	        (mob.position.x - shadow.x) ** 2 + (mob.position.y - shadow.y) ** 2 + (mob.position.z - shadow.z) ** 2 > MOB_DEADBAND_SQ ||
479	        mob.hp !== shadow.hp;
480	      // Delta frames go at half rate (10 Hz) — keyframes always carry everything.
481	      if (!keyframe && (!moved || this.tickCount % 2 !== 0)) continue;
482	      this.mobShadow.set(mob.id, { x: mob.position.x, y: mob.position.y, z: mob.position.z, hp: mob.hp });
483	      out.push({
484	        id: mob.id,
485	        kind: mob.kind,
486	        hostile: mob.hostile,
487	        x: mob.position.x,
488	        y: mob.position.y,
489	        z: mob.position.z,
490	        yaw: mob.yaw,
491	        hp: mob.hp,
492	        moveSpeed: mob.moveSpeed
493	      });
494	    }
495	    if (keyframe) {
496	      const alive = new Set(this.engine.state.mobs.map((m) => m.id));
497	      for (const id of this.mobShadow.keys()) if (!alive.has(id)) this.mobShadow.delete(id);
498	    }
499	    return out;
500	  }
501	
502	  private buildSelfDelta(conn: ClientConn): { self: SelfDelta } | null {
503	    const player = this.engine.state.players.get(conn.playerId);
504	    if (!player) return null;
505	    const effectsKey = JSON.stringify(serializeEffects(player.effects));
506	    const respawnSeconds = Math.ceil(player.respawnTimer);
507	    const previous = conn.shadow;
508	    const delta: SelfDelta = {};
509	    if (!previous || previous.inventory !== player.inventory) delta.inventorySlots = inventorySlotsSnapshot(player.inventory);
510	    if (!previous || previous.equippedArmor !== player.equippedArmor) delta.equippedArmor = serializeEquippedArmor(player.equippedArmor);
511	    if (!previous || previous.selectedSlot !== player.selectedSlot) delta.selectedSlot = player.selectedSlot;
512	    if (!previous || previous.hearts !== player.hearts) delta.hearts = player.hearts;
513	    if (!previous || previous.hunger !== player.hunger) delta.hunger = player.hunger;
514	    if (!previous || Math.abs(previous.oxygen - player.oxygen) > 0.24) delta.oxygen = player.oxygen;
515	    if (!previous || previous.xp !== player.xp) delta.xp = player.xp;
516	    if (!previous || previous.isDead !== player.isDead) delta.isDead = player.isDead;
517	    if (!previous || previous.respawnSeconds !== respawnSeconds) delta.respawnSeconds = respawnSeconds;
518	    if (!previous || previous.gameMode !== player.gameMode) delta.gameMode = player.gameMode;
519	    if (!previous || previous.sleeping !== player.sleeping) delta.sleeping = player.sleeping;
520	    if (!previous || previous.effectsKey !== effectsKey) delta.effects = serializeEffects(player.effects);
521	    conn.shadow = {
522	      inventory: player.inventory,
523	      equippedArmor: player.equippedArmor,
524	      selectedSlot: player.selectedSlot,
525	      hearts: player.hearts,
526	      hunger: player.hunger,
527	      oxygen: player.oxygen,
528	      xp: player.xp,
529	      isDead: player.isDead,
530	      respawnSeconds,
531	      gameMode: player.gameMode,
532	      sleeping: player.sleeping,
533	      effectsKey
534	    };
535	    return Object.keys(delta).length > 0 ? { self: delta } : null;
536	  }
537	
538	  private broadcast(message: ServerMessage, except?: string): void {
539	    const encoded = encodeServerMessage(message);
540	    for (const conn of this.clients.values()) {
541	      if (conn.playerId === except) continue;
542	      this.bytesOut += encoded.length;
543	      conn.sink.send(encoded);
544	    }
545	  }
546	}

27	/**
28	 * The client end of a multiplayer world: owns the WebSocket and a REPLICA
29	 * engine the existing renderer/audio/HUD consume unchanged. Outbound, it
30	 * streams the local player's pose at tick rate and routes commands — local
31	 * presentation stays on the replica, gameplay goes to the server (selectSlot
32	 * optimistically does both). Inbound, it applies the server's block journal,
33	 * replays events into the shell's existing event drain, feeds pose buffers
34	 * for ~125 ms-delayed interpolation, and overwrites the local player's
35	 * private state from self-deltas (the server owns your vitals).
36	 *
37	 * The engine outlives the socket: a dropped connection (anything but a fatal
38	 * close — a bad ticket, a kick, a slow-client shed) runs a reconnect ladder
39	 * that mints a fresh ticket and redoes the handshake, re-syncing the same
40	 * replica in place — the player sees a brief "reconnecting" badge, not a
41	 * dead world.
42	 */
43	
44	export type NetStatus = "connecting" | "syncing" | "online" | "reconnecting" | "closed";
45	
46	/** A fresh place to connect: the reconnect ladder calls this to re-mint a ticket. */
47	export type JoinGrant = { url: string; ticket: string };
48	
49	export type NetworkSessionCallbacks = {
50	  onStatus?(status: NetStatus, detail?: string): void;
51	  onChat?(entry: { from: string; name: string; text: string }): void;
52	  /** Server events the shell's drain should also see (toasts, audio, particles). */
53	  onEvent?(event: GameEvent): void;
54	};
55	
56	export type NetworkSessionOptions = {
57	  /** Socket factory (tests inject a fake). */
58	  makeSocket?: (url: string) => WebSocket;
59	  /** Re-mint a ticket for the reconnect ladder; omit to disable reconnection. */
60	  reconnect?: () => Promise<JoinGrant | null>;
61	  /** Artificial round-trip delay (ms) for local latency testing; overridable at runtime. */
62	  simulatedLatencyMs?: number;
63	  /** Replica world footprint — tests shrink it; production must match the server's (default). */
64	  worldSize?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
65	};
66	
67	/** Closes we don't retry: the door said no, or we'd just be kicked again. */
68	const FATAL_CLOSES = new Set<number>([CLOSE_BAD_TICKET, CLOSE_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH, CLOSE_ROOM_FULL, CLOSE_KICKED, CLOSE_SLOW_CLIENT]);
69	
70	/** Commands that never leave the client: pure presentation on the replica. */
71	const LOCAL_COMMANDS = new Set<Command["type"]>(["toggleInventory", "toggleAdvancements", "toggleDebug", "toggleCameraView", "pause", "resume"]);
72	
73	const HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
74	
75	export type NetworkSession = {
76	  readonly engine: GameEngine;
77	  readonly playerId: PlayerId;
78	  /** UI subscriptions (React components mount after connect; unsubscribe on cleanup). */
79	  subscribeChat(listener: (entry: { from: string; name: string; text: string }) => void): () => void;
80	  subscribeStatus(listener: (status: NetStatus) => void): () => void;
81	  status(): NetStatus;

98	export async function connectNetworkSession(
99	  url: string,
100	  ticket: string,
101	  callbacks: NetworkSessionCallbacks = {},
102	  options: NetworkSessionOptions = {}
103	): Promise<NetworkSession> {
104	  const makeSocket = options.makeSocket ?? ((u: string) => new WebSocket(u));
105	  const envLatency = Number.parseInt(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NET_SIM_LATENCY_MS ?? "", 10);
106	  let simulatedLatencyMs = options.simulatedLatencyMs ?? (Number.isFinite(envLatency) ? envLatency : 0);

108	  let status: NetStatus = "connecting";

114	    status = next;

129	    const socket = ws;
130	    if (!socket || socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;
131	    if (simulatedLatencyMs > 0) {
132	      setTimeout(() => {
133	        try {

135	        } catch {

137	        }

144	  // ── handshake: open a socket, send hello, await welcome ─────────────────────
145	  const handshake = (currentTicket: string, serverUrl: string): Promise<WelcomeMessage> =>
146	    new Promise<WelcomeMessage>((resolve, reject) => {
147	      const socket = makeSocket(`${serverUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/ws`);
148	      socket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";

158	      socket.onopen = () => socket.send(encodeClientMessage({ t: "hello", ticket: currentTicket, protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION }));

161	      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
162	        const message = decodeServerFrame(event.data);

427	  /**
428	   * Applies one client-authoritative pose (server authority): sanity-clamped
429	   * — horizontal speed against the sprint ceiling, vertical against jump/fall
430	   * physics — and rejected wholesale on a teleport-sized jump, in which case
431	   * the caller snaps the client back (forcePose). Accepted movement is
432	   * synthesized into the same summary tickPlayerMotion would have produced,
433	   * so hunger drain, distance stats, and fall damage stay server-authoritative
434	   * even though walking isn't.
435	   *
436	   * `elapsedSeconds` is the time since this player's last ACCEPTED pose.
437	   */
438	  applyRemotePose(
439	    playerId: PlayerId,
440	    pose: { x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number; pitch: number; onGround: boolean },
441	    elapsedSeconds: number
442	  ): { accepted: boolean } {
443	    const player = mustGetPlayer(this.state, playerId);
444	    // Cap elapsed as defense-in-depth: the clamps below scale linearly with it,
445	    // so an unbounded gap (a client withholding accepted poses) would inflate
446	    // the speed ceiling until any jump passes. 0.5s covers real catch-up bursts.
447	    const elapsed = Math.min(Math.max(elapsedSeconds, 0.01), MAX_REMOTE_POSE_ELAPSED);
448	    // A mounted player's pose belongs to the vehicle (server-side); ignore the stream.
449	    if (player.mountedVehicleId !== null) return { accepted: false };
450	
451	    const dx = pose.x - player.position.x;
452	    const dz = pose.z - player.position.z;
453	    const dy = pose.y - player.position.y;
454	    const horizontal = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
455	
456	    const free = isNoclip(player.gameMode) || (player.isFlying && player.gameMode === "creative");
457	    // Generous ceilings: jitter, knockback, and catch-up bursts must not
458	    // false-positive; a speedhack is an order of magnitude out anyway.
459	    const maxHorizontal = (free ? FLY_SPEED : SPRINT_SPEED * speedMultiplier(player)) * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5;
460	    const maxUp = free ? FLY_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5 : (JUMP_VELOCITY + jumpBoostBonus(player)) * elapsed * 1.6 + 0.6;
461	    const maxDown = free ? FLY_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5 : GRAVITY * 2 * Math.max(elapsed, 0.5) * elapsed + 2;
462	
463	    if (horizontal > maxHorizontal || dy > maxUp || -dy > maxDown) return { accepted: false };
464	
465	    const wasGrounded = player.onGround;
466	    const verticalSpeed = dy / elapsed;
467	    player.position.set(pose.x, pose.y, pose.z);
468	    player.yaw = pose.yaw;
469	    player.pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2 + 0.01, Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.01, pose.pitch));
470	    player.onGround = pose.onGround;
471	
472	    // Landing: the same threshold/formula as tickPlayerMotion, on the
473	    // velocity the pose stream implies (Feather Falling honored, armor path).
474	    const didLand = !wasGrounded && pose.onGround && verticalSpeed < 0;
475	    if (!free && didLand && verticalSpeed < -14) {
476	      const raw = Math.min(19, Math.floor((-verticalSpeed - 13) * 0.5));
477	      const softened = raw * (1 - featherFallingReduction(player.equippedArmor.boots));
478	      this.damageCombat(player, Math.max(1, Math.round(softened)));
479	    }
480	
481	    const moving = horizontal > 1e-3;
482	    const didSprint = moving && player.input.move.sprint && !player.input.move.crouch;
483	    const previous = player.remoteMove;
484	    player.remoteMove = {
485	      didSprint,
486	      didWalk: moving && !didSprint,
487	      didJump: (previous?.didJump ?? false) || (wasGrounded && !pose.onGround && verticalSpeed > 2),
488	      didLand: (previous?.didLand ?? false) || didLand,
489	      landImpact: didLand ? -verticalSpeed : (previous?.landImpact ?? 0),
490	      horizontalDistance: (previous?.horizontalDistance ?? 0) + horizontal
491	    };
492	    return { accepted: true };

500	  step(dt: number, input?: FrameInput): void {
501	    const state = this.state;
502	    if (state.paused) {
503	      // Full freeze: mobs, the day clock, mining, and stats all stop.
504	      this.refreshSnapshot();

506	    }
507	    const primary = state.players.get(state.primaryPlayerId) ?? null;
508	    if (input && primary) primary.input = input;

510	    // knows the abstract sprint intent — the binding lives in the controller.
511	    if (primary) state.capsActive = primary.input.move.sprint;
512	
513	    // A replica advances only the local player's prediction + presentation:
514	    // own movement (the pose stream's source), cosmetic mining progress for
515	    // the crack overlay (the BREAK arrives as a server event), and the day
516	    // clock (corrected by the server every second). Everything else — mobs,
517	    // spawns, random ticks, TNT, projectiles, vitals — is replicated state
518	    // that NetworkSession writes in, never simulated here.
519	    if (this.replica) {
520	      if (primary && !primary.isDead && state.sleepTimer <= 0) {
521	        tickPlayerMotion(state, primary, primary.input, dt, () => {});
522	        tickMining(state, primary, primary.input, dt, this.emit, this.rng, { cosmetic: true });
523	      }
524	      if (state.sleepTimer > 0) state.sleepTimer = Math.max(0, state.sleepTimer - dt);
525	      tickDayNight(state, dt);
526	      tickWeather(state);
527	      this.tickDebugInfo(dt);
528	      this.refreshSnapshot();
529	      return;
530	    }
531	
532	    // Single-player death semantics: while the (primary) player is dead, only
533	    // mobs, lit fuses, and in-flight arrows tick. An authoritative server never
534	    // freezes a shared world for one death — each player's respawn countdown
535	    // runs inside their own per-player step below instead.
536	    if (this.authority === "local" && primary?.isDead) {
537	      if (tickRespawnTimer(primary, dt)) this.respawn(primary);
538	      else {
539	        tickMobs(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
540	        // Keep ticking so lit fuses and in-flight arrows resolve instead of
541	        // freezing for the respawn countdown; damage no-ops while dead.
542	        tickPrimedTnt(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
543	        tickProjectiles(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);

546	      return;
547	    }

60	  // a stuck one. Movement stays gated by canOccupy, so a beached boat still can't drive

77	function vehicleCorners(vehicle: VehicleState): Array<[number, number]> {
78	  const spec = specFor(vehicle.kind);
79	  const sin = Math.sin(vehicle.yaw);
80	  const cos = Math.cos(vehicle.yaw);
81	  const { x, z } = vehicle.position;
82	  const hw = spec.halfWidth;
83	  const hl = spec.halfLength;
84	  scratchCorners[0][0] = x - hw * cos + hl * sin;
85	  scratchCorners[0][1] = z - hw * sin - hl * cos;
86	  scratchCorners[1][0] = x - hw * cos - hl * sin;
87	  scratchCorners[1][1] = z - hw * sin + hl * cos;
88	  scratchCorners[2][0] = x + hw * cos + hl * sin;
89	  scratchCorners[2][1] = z + hw * sin - hl * cos;
90	  scratchCorners[3][0] = x + hw * cos - hl * sin;
91	  scratchCorners[3][1] = z + hw * sin + hl * cos;
92	  scratchCorners[4][0] = x;
93	  scratchCorners[4][1] = z;
94	  return scratchCorners;

97	function vehicleHasWaterSupport(state: GameState, vehicle: VehicleState): boolean {

99	  const deckY = Math.floor(vehicle.position.y);
100	  for (const [x, z] of vehicleCorners(vehicle)) {
101	    const fx = Math.floor(x);
102	    const fz = Math.floor(z);
103	    if (state.world.get(fx, waterY, fz) !== BlockId.Water) return false;
104	    if (state.world.get(fx, deckY, fz) !== BlockId.Air) return false;

109	function vehicleOverlaps(a: VehicleState, b: VehicleState): boolean {

113	  const radiusB = Math.hypot(bs.halfWidth, bs.halfLength);
114	  return Math.hypot(a.position.x - b.position.x, a.position.z - b.position.z) < radiusA + radiusB;

150	    [spec.halfWidth + 0.8, 0],
151	    [-spec.halfWidth - 0.8, 0],
152	    [VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS, VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS],
153	    [-VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS, VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS],
154	    [VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS, -VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS],
155	    [-VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS, -VEHICLE_DISMOUNT_RADIUS]
156	  ];
157	  const sin = Math.sin(vehicle.yaw);
158	  const cos = Math.cos(vehicle.yaw);
159	  for (const [lx, lz] of offsets) {
160	    const x = vehicle.position.x + lx * cos - lz * sin;
161	    const z = vehicle.position.z + lx * sin + lz * cos;
162	    for (let y = Math.floor(vehicle.position.y + 1); y >= Math.floor(vehicle.position.y - 1); y -= 1) {
163	      scratchCandidate.set(x, y, z);
164	      if (collidesAt(state.world, scratchCandidate, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) continue;
165	      vehicle.rider = null;
166	      player.mountedVehicleId = null;
167	      player.position.copy(scratchCandidate);
168	      player.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);
169	      player.onGround = false;
170	      return true;
171	    }
172	  }
173	  return false;
174	}
175	
176	function syncPlayerToVehicle(player: PlayerState, vehicle: VehicleState): void {
177	  player.position.set(vehicle.position.x, vehicle.position.y + 0.16, vehicle.position.z);
178	  // The rider's own velocity is inert while mounted (player motion is skipped); keep it
179	  // zeroed so a later dismount starts from rest rather than inheriting a stale value.
180	  player.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);
181	  player.onGround = true;
182	}
183	
184	function aimedVehicle(state: GameState, player: PlayerState): VehicleState | null {
185	  scratchEye.set(player.position.x, player.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, player.position.z);
186	  lookDirection(player.yaw, player.pitch, scratchDir);
187	  let best: VehicleState | null = null;
188	  let bestT = VEHICLE_BOARD_REACH;
189	  for (const vehicle of state.vehicles) {
190	    const to = scratchCandidate.copy(vehicle.position).sub(scratchEye);
191	    const t = to.dot(scratchDir);
192	    if (t < 0 || t > bestT) continue;
193	    const closestX = scratchEye.x + scratchDir.x * t;
194	    const closestY = scratchEye.y + scratchDir.y * t;
195	    const closestZ = scratchEye.z + scratchDir.z * t;
196	    const spec = specFor(vehicle.kind);
197	    const radius = Math.hypot(spec.halfWidth, spec.halfLength);
198	    if (Math.hypot(vehicle.position.x - closestX, vehicle.position.y - closestY, vehicle.position.z - closestZ) > radius) continue;
199	    best = vehicle;
200	    bestT = t;
201	  }
202	  return best;
203	}
204	
205	export function tryBoardAimedVehicle(state: GameState, player: PlayerState): boolean {
206	  const vehicle = aimedVehicle(state, player);
207	  if (!vehicle || vehicle.rider !== null) return false;
208	  mountVehicle(state, player, vehicle);
209	  return true;
210	}
211	
212	export function tryPlaceVehicle(state: GameState, player: PlayerState, emit: EmitGameEvent): boolean {
213	  const slot = player.inventory[player.selectedSlot];
214	  if (slot?.id !== "raft" && slot?.id !== "ship") return false;
215	  const kind = slot.id;
216	  if (state.vehicles.length >= MAX_VEHICLES) {
217	    emit({ type: "vehiclePlaceFailed" }); // world is at the vehicle cap — refuse to keep saves bounded
218	    return true;
219	  }
220	  scratchEye.set(player.position.x, player.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, player.position.z);
221	  lookDirection(player.yaw, player.pitch, scratchDir);
222	  const water = waterSurfaceRaycast(state.world, scratchEye, scratchDir, VEHICLE_BOARD_REACH);
223	  if (!water) {
224	    emit({ type: "vehiclePlaceFailed" }); // no water in reach — cue the "can't place here" thud
225	    return true;
226	  }
227	  const vehicle = makeVehicle(state, kind, water.x + 0.5, water.y + 1, water.z + 0.5, player.yaw);
228	  if (!canOccupy(state, vehicle)) {
229	    emit({ type: "vehiclePlaceFailed" }); // spot is blocked, out of bounds, or overlaps another boat
230	    return true;
231	  }
232	  state.vehicles.push(vehicle);
233	  if (player.gameMode !== "creative") player.inventory = adjustSlotCount(player.inventory, kind, -1, player.selectedSlot) ?? player.inventory;
234	  emit({ type: "vehiclePlaced", kind });
235	  return true;
236	}
237	
238	export function tickVehicles(state: GameState, player: PlayerState, input: FrameInput, dt: number): void {
239	  const mounted = player.mountedVehicleId === null ? null : (state.vehicles.find((vehicle) => vehicle.id === player.mountedVehicleId) ?? null);
240	  if (mounted) {
241	    if (input.move.crouch && dismountVehicle(state, player, mounted)) return;
242	    const forwardInput = (input.move.forward ? 1 : 0) - (input.move.back ? 1 : 0);
243	    const turnInput = (input.move.right ? 1 : 0) - (input.move.left ? 1 : 0);
244	    mounted.yaw -= turnInput * VEHICLE_TURN_RATE * dt;
245	    scratchForward.set(-Math.sin(mounted.yaw), 0, -Math.cos(mounted.yaw));
246	    const speed = specFor(mounted.kind).speed * forwardInput;
247	    const prevX = mounted.position.x;
248	    const prevZ = mounted.position.z;
249	    mounted.position.x += scratchForward.x * speed * dt;
250	    mounted.position.z += scratchForward.z * speed * dt;
251	    if (!canOccupy(state, mounted)) {
252	      mounted.position.x = prevX;
253	      mounted.position.z = prevZ;
254	    }
255	    syncPlayerToVehicle(player, mounted);
256	    return;
257	  }
258	
259	  for (const vehicle of state.vehicles) {
260	    if (vehicle.kind !== "ship" || vehicle.rider !== null) continue;
261	    const spec = specFor(vehicle.kind);
262	    scratchRight.set(Math.cos(vehicle.yaw), 0, Math.sin(vehicle.yaw));
263	    scratchForward.set(-Math.sin(vehicle.yaw), 0, -Math.cos(vehicle.yaw));
264	    const dx = player.position.x - vehicle.position.x;
265	    const dz = player.position.z - vehicle.position.z;
266	    const localX = dx * scratchRight.x + dz * scratchRight.z;
267	    const localZ = dx * scratchForward.x + dz * scratchForward.z;
268	    if (Math.abs(localX) <= spec.halfWidth && Math.abs(localZ) <= spec.halfLength && Math.abs(player.position.y - vehicle.position.y) <= 1.2) {
269	      mountVehicle(state, player, vehicle);
270	      break;
271	    }
272	  }
273	}
274

661	  /**
662	   * Applies a discrete player intent. `playerId` says whose intent it is —
663	   * the single-player shell omits it (primary); a server passes the sender's
664	   * id, so every mutation in here acts on the commanding player.
665	   */
666	  dispatch(command: Command, playerId?: PlayerId): void {
667	    if (this.routeDispatch && playerId === undefined) {
668	      this.routeDispatch(command);
669	      return;
670	    }
671	    const state = this.state;
672	    const player = mustGetPlayer(state, playerId ?? state.primaryPlayerId);
673	    switch (command.type) {
674	      case "selectSlot": {
675	        if (command.index >= 0 && command.index < Math.min(HOTBAR_SLOTS, player.inventory.length)) {
676	          player.selectedSlot = command.index;
677	        }
678	        break;
679	      }
680	      case "toggleInventory": {
681	        if (!canInteract(player.gameMode)) break; // Spectator has no inventory
682	        player.inventoryOpen = !player.inventoryOpen;
683	        if (player.inventoryOpen) player.advancementsOpen = false; // the two full-screen overlays are mutually exclusive
684	        if (!player.inventoryOpen) {
685	          player.craftingStation = null; // leaving the panel closes the station
686	          player.activeVillagerProfession = null; // ...and the open villager's trades
687	          player.openContainerIndex = null; // ...and the open chest
688	        }
689	        break;
690	      }
691	      case "toggleAdvancements": {
692	        // A read-only progression overlay — available in any mode (even Spectator).
693	        player.advancementsOpen = !player.advancementsOpen;
694	        if (player.advancementsOpen) {
695	          player.inventoryOpen = false; // mutually exclusive with the inventory panel
696	          player.craftingStation = null;
697	          player.activeVillagerProfession = null;
698	          player.openContainerIndex = null;
699	        }

Vehicles never despawn, so no absence-pruning.\n   */\n  private collectVehiclePoses(force: boolean): VehiclePose[] {\n    const out: VehiclePose[] = [];\n    for (const vehicle of this.engine.state.vehicles) {\n      const riderId = vehicle.rider;\n      const shadow = this.vehicleShadow.get(vehicle.id);\n      const moved =\n        !shadow ||\n        (vehicle.position.x - shadow.x) ** 2 + (vehicle.position.y - shadow.y) ** 2 + (vehicle.position.z - shadow.z) ** 2 > MOB_DEADBAND_SQ ||\n        vehicle.yaw !== shadow.yaw ||\n        riderId !== shadow.riderId;\n      if (!force && !moved) continue;\n      this.vehicleShadow.set(vehicle.id, { x: vehicle.position.x, y: vehicle.position.y, z: vehicle.position.z, yaw: vehicle.yaw, riderId });\n      out.push({ id: vehicle.id, kind: vehicle.kind, x: vehicle.position.x, y: vehicle.position.y, z: vehicle.position.z, yaw: vehicle.yaw, riderId });\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  /** Every live arrow, full state each tick (they're few and fast — no deadband; the client snaps and prunes by absence). */\n  private collectProjectilePoses(): ProjectilePose[] {\n    return this.engine.state.projectiles.map((p) => ({\n      id: p.id,\n      x: p.position.x,\n      y: p.position.y,\n      z: p.position.z,\n      vx: p.velocity.x,\n      vy: p.velocity.y,\n      vz: p.velocity.z\n    }));\n  }"

6	/**
7	 * The client session end-to-end against a scriptable fake socket: the
8	 * handshake, command routing (local vs networked), self-delta application,
9	 * chat, the simulated-latency knob, and — the Phase 6 headline — the
10	 * reconnect ladder resuming the SAME replica after a non-fatal drop. Driving
11	 * a real browser socket-kill would be flaky; a fake makes every edge
12	 * deterministic (the server half is covered by server/room.test.ts).

45	    players
46	  };
47	}

49	/** A minimal scriptable WebSocket: auto-answers the hello with a welcome, records sends, lets the test emit frames. */
50	class FakeSocket {
51	  static OPEN = 1;
52	  readyState = 0;
53	  binaryType = "blob";
54	  onopen: (() => void) | null = null;
55	  onmessage: ((event: { data: unknown }) => void) | null = null;
56	  onclose: ((event: { code: number; reason: string }) => void) | null = null;
57	  onerror: (() => void) | null = null;
58	  readonly sent: string[] = [];
59	
60	  constructor(
61	    public url: string,
62	    private readonly welcome: WelcomeMessage
63	  ) {
64	    queueMicrotask(() => {
65	      this.readyState = 1;
66	      this.onopen?.();
67	    });
68	  }
69	
70	  send(data: string): void {
71	    this.sent.push(data);
72	    const message = JSON.parse(data) as { t: string };
73	    if (message.t === "hello") this.onmessage?.({ data: JSON.stringify(this.welcome) });
74	  }
75	
76	  emit(data: unknown): void {
77	    this.onmessage?.({ data });
78	  }
79	
80	  emitClose(code: number, reason = ""): void {
81	    this.readyState = 3;
82	    this.onclose?.({ code, reason });
83	  }
84	
85	  close(code = 1000, reason = ""): void {
86	    this.emitClose(code, reason);
87	  }
88	
89	  sentTypes(): string[] {
90	    return this.sent.map((s) => (JSON.parse(s) as { t: string }).t);
91	  }
92	}
93	
94	function socketFactory(welcome: WelcomeMessage = WELCOME) {
95	  const instances: FakeSocket[] = [];
96	  const make = (url: string) => {
97	    const socket = new FakeSocket(url, welcome);
98	    instances.push(socket);
99	    return socket as unknown as WebSocket;
100	  };
101	  return { make, instances };
102	}
